sentences.en: Mars contains highlands which occur in the southern hemisphere.
sentences.zh: 火星的南部半球有高地。

sentences.en: The potato is native to the highlands of Central and South America.
sentences.zh: 土豆原产于中南美洲的高海拔地区。

sentences.en: Algeria's territory is largely made of highlands.
sentences.zh: 阿尔及利亚的领土主要由高地构成。
